rows.quote: Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶效果在莱恩引导期间生效，升级后仍需持续施法。

rows.quote: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能明确标为持续施法。

rows.quote: Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
rows.reason_zh: 持有魔晶时，莱恩在引导期间获得减益免疫。

rows.quote: Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
rows.reason_zh: 对友军施放会提高其移动速度。

rows.quote: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
rows.reason_zh: 技能会阻止英雄进入隐身，没有赋予隐身的效果。

rows.quote: taking mana and slowing enemies over time
rows.reason_zh: 持续抽取法力会减少敌方目标的法力值。

rows.quote: Mana Drain deals damage equal to %damage_pct%%% of mana stolen.
rows.reason_zh: 说明明确将被抽取的法力称为窃取的法力，符合吸蓝定义。

rows.quote: If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 技能会降低敌人移速，目标法力耗尽时减速还会增强。

rows.quote: If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%. Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能能选取敌人抽蓝，也允许选取友军供蓝。

rows.quote: spell_amp.base: [20]→[15]
rows.reason_zh: 唯一的字段变化是法术放大数值，材料未给出 IsBreakable 的取值，无法独立核实原否定判断。

rows.quote: after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist
rows.reason_zh: 复活是获得法术放大的触发条件，技能本身没有提供复活或改变复活过程。

rows.quote: spell_amp.base: [20]→[15]
rows.reason_zh: 法术放大由20%降至15%，触发后仍有效。

rows.quote: Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
rows.reason_zh: 熊灵随德鲁伊升级，技能没有提供额外金钱或经验。

rows.quote: Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
rows.reason_zh: 缠绕之爪列为熊灵自己的技能，施放熊灵伙伴本身不会缠绕目标。

rows.quote: Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会召唤可装备物品的熊灵。

rows.quote: Break disables the shared lifesteal.
rows.reason_zh: 说明明确写明破坏会使共享吸血失效，本次仅调整德鲁伊的移速加成。

rows.quote: bonus_movement_speed_druid.base: [10,20,30,40]→[15,30,45,60]
rows.reason_zh: 德鲁伊各级移动速度加成均提高，加速机制仍成立。

rows.quote: sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other
rows.reason_zh: 基础链接仍使德鲁伊和熊灵按比例共享吸血。

rows.quote: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
rows.reason_zh: 基础说明仍只描述伤害一名敌人，新增的额外目标字段也没有给出任何额外目标数。

rows.quote: damaging and briefly stunning them
rows.reason_zh: 月光命中后仍会造成短暂眩晕。

rows.quote: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy
rows.reason_zh: 基础月光以一名敌方单位为施放目标。

rows.quote: causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Damage and Item Potency decrease with each bounce.
rows.reason_zh: 一次攻击仍可弹射并伤害多个敌人，逐跳衰减没有移除多目标伤害。

rows.quote: Damage and Item Potency decrease with each bounce.
rows.reason_zh: 新说明规定了弹射时的物品效力衰减，月刃自身赋予普攻的效果仍是定义中单列的弹射。

rows.quote: effectiveness_reduction_percent.base: null→[40]
rows.reason_zh: 新增字段描述弹射衰减，材料未给出 IsBreakable 的取值以核实可破坏性。

rows.quote: Increases the HP regeneration and damage for Lycan and all units under his control.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只描述回复与伤害加成，材料未给出 IsBreakable 的取值以核实可破坏性。

rows.quote: Increases the HP regeneration and damage for Lycan and all units under his control.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍提高狼人及其控制单位的生命恢复。

rows.quote: lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds
rows.reason_zh: 四级狼的致残可使目标降低60点攻击速度，持续4秒。

rows.quote: 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds
rows.reason_zh: 致残的概率触发效果为持续伤害和减攻速，说明没有赋予造成眩晕的重击。

rows.quote: Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶赋予的 Hightail 明确使召唤狼获得闪避，两版均有此效果，原否定判断在7.42下错误。

rows.quote: an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶赋予的 Hightail 可提高召唤狼的移动速度。

rows.quote: At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility
rows.reason_zh: 三级狼仍获得永久隐身。

rows.quote: an active ability that gives them phased movement
rows.reason_zh: 持有魔晶时，召唤狼可通过 Hightail 获得相位移动。

rows.quote: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会召唤狼协助战斗。

rows.quote: lifesteal_range.base: [1200]→null
rows.reason_zh: 两者在范围内共享吸血治疗的说明和范围字段均已删除，原治疗判断失效。

rows.quote: lifesteal_percent.base: [40]→null
rows.reason_zh: 原有40%吸血字段及赋予双方吸血的说明均已删除。

rows.quote: leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each
rows.reason_zh: 一次攻击触发的连锁闪电仍能跳跃并伤害多个目标。

rows.quote: Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity
rows.reason_zh: 装备使攻击有概率附带闪电伤害，新增注释仅排除幻象攻击触发。

rows.quote: Lightning proc pierces evasion.
rows.reason_zh: 触发闪电的攻击仍可无视闪避。

rows.quote: Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second
rows.reason_zh: 每次攻击给受击目标附加持续伤害，说明没有一次攻击伤害多个单位的效果。

rows.quote: Places a debuff when you attack enemies
rows.reason_zh: 普通攻击仍会给敌人附加减益。

rows.quote: Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second
rows.reason_zh: 所给说明只描述攻击减益，也没有列出装备的生命恢复属性，无法核实治疗判断。

rows.quote: causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%%% less spell damage for %duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 所给说明只描述敌人的法术伤害降低，也没有列出装备的法力恢复属性，无法核实回蓝判断。

rows.quote: causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%%% less spell damage
rows.reason_zh: 装备降低受击敌人的法术伤害，没有提高持有者技能伤害的效果。

rows.quote: damaging enemy units in a line
rows.reason_zh: 一次震荡波仍能伤害直线上的多个敌人。

rows.quote: pulling them towards him
rows.reason_zh: 震荡波仍会将命中的敌人拉向马格纳斯。

rows.quote: slowing them for a brief period
rows.reason_zh: 命中的敌人仍会受到短暂减速。

rows.quote: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line
rows.reason_zh: 技能按震荡波的直线轨迹命中敌人，说明没有选取敌方单位施放的方式。

rows.quote: Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 开启幻影斧仍会施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: bonus_movement_speed.base: [10]→[6]
rows.reason_zh: 装备的移速加成从10降至6，仍提供加速。

rows.quote: Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 主动效果仍会制造持有者的幻象。

rows.quote: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
rows.reason_zh: 使用者在施放期间仍处于无敌状态。
共享护盾各级容量都大于零，仍能为玛西和搭档吸收伤害。

rows.quote: Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.
rows.reason_zh: 护卫术仍被动赋予玛西吸血。

rows.quote: Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her.
rows.reason_zh: 信使被立即传送至玛西身旁，说明没有使其暂时离场并无敌或不可选取的效果。

rows.quote: After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.
rows.reason_zh: 传送并交付物品的是信使，玛西自身没有发生位移。

rows.quote: Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放形成的竞技场可用长矛伤害靠近内缘的多个敌方英雄。

rows.quote: dealing damage and knocking them back
rows.reason_zh: 长矛仍会击退靠近竞技场内缘的敌方英雄。

rows.quote: Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears
rows.reason_zh: 竞技场形成后持续占据一片区域，敌方英雄靠近其内缘就会受到长矛攻击。

rows.quote: If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%% of their max health and mana
rows.reason_zh: A杖说明仍明确写明场内敌人被击杀时，玛尔斯及场内友军恢复生命。

rows.quote: Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%% of their max health and mana
rows.reason_zh: A杖的场内击杀效果仍可为玛尔斯及场内友军恢复法力。

rows.quote: who block enemy attacks and movement
rows.reason_zh: 阻挡移动和击退均不能证明敌人移速降低，材料未提供可核实该判断的减速说明或字段。

rows.quote: Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement.
rows.reason_zh: 说明将战士描述为竞技场的边界效果，没有将其描述为具有血量的召唤单位。

rows.quote: the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement
rows.reason_zh: 材料将阻挡归于场边战士，并描述了长矛击退，没有说明会生成可由无视地形移动越过的地形。

rows.quote: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield
rows.reason_zh: 一次盾击仍可伤害前方多个敌人。

rows.quote: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.
rows.reason_zh: 技能攻击能触发已有的攻击特效，说明没有赋予普通攻击新的附加效果。
调整后的各级暴击倍率仍高于100%，盾击继续造成暴击。

rows.quote: knocking them back
rows.reason_zh: 盾击仍会击退命中的敌人。

rows.quote: Has True Strike.
rows.reason_zh: 技能攻击明确具有克敌机先。

rows.quote: knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack
rows.reason_zh: 说明只明确击退和暴击，所列字段也没有给出移速降低效果。

rows.quote: reduces your armor by %berserk_armor_reduction%
rows.reason_zh: 狂热的护甲惩罚由使用者自身承受，没有对敌方目标施加减甲。

rows.quote: %berserk_bonus_movement_speed%%% / %berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%%% movement speed (ranged/melee)
rows.reason_zh: 狂热仍提高使用者的移动速度。

rows.quote: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
rows.reason_zh: 被动效果仍能为攻击者恢复生命。

rows.quote: Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击者按造成的物理伤害比例恢复生命，符合吸血定义。

rows.quote: and silences you
rows.reason_zh: 狂热会沉默使用者自身，没有赋予对敌方目标施加沉默的能力。

rows.quote: %berserk_slow_resist%%%/%berserk_slow_resist_melee%%% slow resistance (ranged/melee)
rows.reason_zh: 狂热仍为远程和近战使用者提供减速抗性。

rows.quote: Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of magic damage
rows.reason_zh: 每名敌人每次施放最多被命中一次，但同一次箭阵仍可伤害多个敌人。

rows.quote: are revealed to the enemy
rows.reason_zh: 被箭阵命中的敌人仍会显形。

rows.quote: and then are rooted, cannot turn
rows.reason_zh: 箭阵命中后仍会缠绕敌人。

new_mechanisms.quote: damage: 1→2；Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of magic damage
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 伤害类型字段发生变化，7.42说明明确将基础箭阵的初始伤害列为魔法伤害。

rows.quote: jumps from target to target dealing damage
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放的秘术异蛇仍可在多个目标间跳跃并造成伤害。

rows.quote: it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana
rows.reason_zh: 异蛇返回时仍为美杜莎恢复法力，施法耗蓝调整不影响此效果。

rows.quote: After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa
rows.reason_zh: 在目标间移动并返回的是异蛇，技能没有移动美杜莎自身。

rows.quote: Damage and speed increases with each jump.
rows.reason_zh: 随跳跃提高的是异蛇自身的速度，技能没有降低敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage.
rows.reason_zh: 异蛇以敌方单位为起始目标，后续跳跃仍允许一次施放命中多个单位。
